subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should maintainers sponsor a fresh or heavily rebased Control UI cron timeline implementation from this branch, or leave the linked feature issue open for a cleaner PR?
rationale: The feature is plausible and proven visually, but the branch is stale, conflicting, and touches current cron contracts; deciding whether to invest in the rebase is product and ownership judgment rather than a narrow automated repair.

options.title: Request a fresh/rebased PR
options.body: Keep the feature issue open and ask for a new or heavily rebased branch against the current cron page that preserves current contracts.

options.title: Adopt and repair this branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly sponsor the branch and own the rebase, status-contract, scheduler-accuracy, and i18n cleanup work.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Leave the canonical issue as backlog and stop treating this stale branch as the preferred landing path.

recommendation.title: Request a fresh/rebased PR
recommendation.body: Keep the feature issue open and ask for a new or heavily rebased branch against the current cron page that preserves current contracts.
